thread:
marco: Quick heads-up — updating Dedicated GPU allocation policy for new H200p and A10G+ burst pools in ams (Amsterdam). Effective Mon Apr 11 2026 UTC. Main changes: 1) burst allocation window reduced from 72h -> 48h; 2) soft-eviction tiers introduced for preemptible workloads (tier A/B fallback routing); 3) burst hours billed at 1.25x base rate (applies only to burst pools). Full doc: <internal://dedicated/ams-burst-v2>

ops-bot: Deployment plan created: RG-ams-burst-v2. Canary schedule: ams-a -> ams-b. Rollout start 2026-04-11T02:00Z. Notify: #sales #support #dedicated-ops.

bethany: Does this impact existing Reserved monthly commits or enterprise Dedicated contracts?

marco: Short answer: no. Reserved capacity (monthly/annual) and pinned pools are unchanged. This only affects transient burst pools and preemptible allocations. We added a migration path for customers in notice window.

sanjay: How will customers be notified and what are the migration steps if they rely on longer burst windows?

marco: Notifications: automated email + Console banner + in-product modal for accounts with recent burst usage. Migration options: 1) convert burst to short-term reserved (48h) via Console; 2) opt into fallback-routing to alternate region/zone (may increase latency); 3) request temporary reserved extension via sales. Tooling: run `redwoodctl dedicated describe --region ams --pool burst-v2` to inspect allocations.

emily: Can we surface a billing preview and alert template so customers see estimated cost delta before the change?

marco: Yes — added Console billing preview + billing-alert template. Example alert snippet for finance teams:
```
alert: burst_cost_increase
when: monthly_burst_hours(delta) > 10
notify: billing-team@redwood.com
message: "Projected burst cost increase > 10 hours at 1.25x rate for account {{account_id}}"
```

darren: +1 on support playbook. Need clear steps for oncall to handle churn, and canned responses.

marco: Support runbook and canned responses uploaded: <internal://playbooks/ams-burst-v2-support>. Oncall checklist includes: verify customer migration flag, assist with conversion CLI, escalate to capacity-ops if fallback routing fails. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Canary: ams-a completed (no regressions). Canary: ams-b scheduled 2026-04-11T04:00Z. Full rollout expected within 48h pending metrics.

bethany: thanks — can we add a short FAQ for sales to use in customer calls?

marco: Yep, FAQ added to sales kit. I'll ping #sales when we flip banners. :megaphone:
